set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=07bc0aa1a53a55ff920f1f9ef028c8602fcaa182
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
git fetch -q origin agent-control mvp/environment-controller
test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
raw = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/agent-control:.agent/tasks/20260904-growbox-stage28a-rf433-codec-host-v1.json'], text=True)
task = json.loads(raw)
subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',task['commands'][0]], check=True)
path = Path('test/test_rf433_protocol/test_main.cpp')
text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
needle = 'assert(decoded.estimated_pulse_us == protocolSpec(protocol)->default_pulse_us);'
replacement = '''// The Stage28 RF transport uses a fixed 100 kHz RMT clock, so pulse lengths are
    // represented in 10 us ticks. Protocol 10's nominal 365 us therefore round-trips
    // as 370 us; verify the codec's quantized value rather than an unrepresentable ideal.
    const auto nominal_pulse_us =
        static_cast<std::uint32_t>(protocolSpec(protocol)->default_pulse_us);
    const auto expected_quantized_pulse_us =
        static_cast<std::uint16_t>(((nominal_pulse_us + 5U) / 10U) * 10U);
    assert(decoded.estimated_pulse_us == expected_quantized_pulse_us);'''
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit('expected pulse assertion not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(needle, replacement), encoding='utf-8')
PY
git diff --check
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-stage28a
cmake --build build/host-stage28a --target rf433_protocol_tests -j2
ctest --test-dir build/host-stage28a -R '^rf433_protocol_tests$' --output-on-failure
cmake --build build/host-stage28a -j2
ctest --test-dir build/host-stage28a --output-on-failure
git diff --check
git status --short
git add src/climate/rf433 test/test_rf433_protocol test/host/CMakeLists.txt
git commit -m 'Add portable RF433 codec and temporal policy'
git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller
test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
printf 'STAGE28A_RF433_CODEC_FIX_OK commit=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
